_meta.rule: HOTLINES: NEVER add or edit a hotline/text-line number without a human verifying it against an authoritative source (source=national_verified, verified=true). EMERGENCY numbers (police/ambulance/fire): emitted only under the owner's cited-sources standard of 2026-10-29 — >=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official, source=multi_source_cited (CIRISAgent#1248). A wrong crisis number is catastrophically worse than the directory fallback.

verification_notes: No human-verified national hotline entries for this locale yet — international directories only. See CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md before adding entries; numbers require human verification (verified=true) against an authoritative source. Emergency (police/ambulance/fire) numbers for ES, MX, CO, AR added 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248): 7 of 8 meet the owner's cited-sources standard (source=multi_source_cited, emitted); the rest are staged verified=false and NOT emitted — see CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md.

emergency_spain_112.name: Emergency services

Sources: UK FCDO travel advice: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Spain Telephone: 112 (ambulance, fire, police)" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API) | AOSP eccdata (Android's emergency-number database): ES 112 types ['AMBULANCE', 'FIRE', 'POLICE']. emergency_colombia_123.name: Emergency services
emergency_colombia_123.description: Emergency number — fire, police (some sources also list: ambulance)
emergency_colombia_123.validation_notes: CITED 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248) under the owner's cited-sources standard (>=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official; no human check). Sources: UK FCDO travel advice: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Colombia Ambulance: 123 Fire: 119 Police: 123" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API) | Alcaldía Mayor de Bogotá (municipal government): "antes de mayo de 2007, las personas reportaban los incidentes en varias líneas telefónicas, por ejemplo: 112 para Policía; 119 Bomberos, 125 Salud y 127 Tránsito. A partir de ese año, estos canales se unificaron en el Número Único de Seguridad y Emergencias 123" (https://bogota.gov.co/mi-ciudad/seguridad/linea-123-que-cumple-17-anos-al-servicio-de-la-ciudadania) | AOSP eccdata (Android's emergency-number database): CO 123 types ['AMBULANCE', 'FIRE', 'POLICE']. Sources agree it reaches: fire, police. Listed beyond that by some sources only: ambulance. UK FCDO page checked: https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/colombia/getting-help (fetched 2026-10-29); page text: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Colombia Ambulance: 123 Fire: 119 Police: 123" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API). Cross-check (not a source): en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_emergency_telephone_numbers — wikipedia agrees 123 is the general emergency line (it also lists police 112, ambulance 125).
